definitions.explanation: A strong thick line made of twisted fibers or strands.
The sacred rope worn by yokozuna (grand champion) in sumo wrestling.

notes:
{綱|つな} refers to thick rope or cord, typically stronger and thicker than ⟦{紐|ひも}→紐：02251_himo⟧ (string) or ⟦{縄|なわ}→縄：03511_nawa⟧ (thinner rope). It also has a specialized meaning in sumo as the sacred rope belt of a ⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{綱引|つなひ}き→綱引き：17398_tsunahiki⟧: tug-of-war (school and festival event)
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{綱|つな}: lifeline (literal or figurative)
- ⟦{綱渡|つなわた}り→綱渡り：20585_tsunawatari⟧: tightrope walking; figuratively, a risky balancing act
- ⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧: sumo grand champion (literally "side rope")

SUMO USAGE:
In sumo, {綱|つな} refers to the sacred rope (⟦{注連縄|しめなわ}→注連縄：06015_shimenawa⟧-style) worn by the ⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧ during the ring-entering ceremony (⟦{土俵入|どひょうい}り→土俵入り：28261_dohyouiri⟧). It has ⟦{紙垂|しで}→紙垂：28322_shide⟧ (paper streamers) attached.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{紐|ひも}→紐：02251_himo⟧: string, thin cord (thinner than {綱|つな})
- ⟦{縄|なわ}→縄：03511_nawa⟧: rope (general, thinner, used for tying)
- ⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧: rope (loanword, often for climbing or utility)
